statement: WiiBrew's Wii Remote EEPROM calibration section documents redundant blocks whose final byte is an additive checksum (sum of preceding bytes plus 0x55); it describes Nintendo software using the first checksum-valid calibration set, then the backup, and finally a default fallback. This is documented consumer/calibration policy, not evidence of particular factory calibration values or a measured imported image.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 123257 section EEPROM Memory calibration and source emulator additive checksum function in WiimoteEmu.h 76-95; default calibration bytes intentionally omitted.
